claims.name: Experiments.Pal24IntervalSlack.SlackClass
claims.statement: Finite outcome tags FEASIBLE, VIOLATED, CONTACT, and UNRESOLVED.
claims.ceiling: Tags only; no evaluator or receipt authenticity.
claims.residual: No semantic status outside the declared classifier.

claims.name: Experiments.Pal24IntervalSlack.SlackInterval
claims.statement: Raw rational interval with lower and upper endpoints.
claims.residual: Units and measurement uncertainty provenance are omitted.

claims.name: Experiments.Pal24IntervalSlack.validInterval
claims.statement: Interval validity predicate lower ≤ upper.
claims.residual: Does not establish units or source data quality.

claims.name: Experiments.Pal24IntervalSlack.constraintToSlack
claims.statement: Maps [c_lo,c_hi] to [-c_hi,-c_lo].

claims.name: Experiments.Pal24IntervalSlack.feasible
claims.statement: Predicate s_lo > ε.

claims.name: Experiments.Pal24IntervalSlack.violated
claims.statement: Predicate s_hi < -ε.

claims.name: Experiments.Pal24IntervalSlack.contact
claims.statement: Predicate -ε ≤ s_lo and s_hi ≤ ε.

claims.name: Experiments.Pal24IntervalSlack.classify
claims.statement: Prioritized source predicates with residual UNRESOLVED.

claims.name: Experiments.Pal24IntervalSlack.constraintToSlack_valid
claims.statement: Negation preserves interval ordering while reversing endpoints.

claims.name: Experiments.Pal24IntervalSlack.feasible_not_violated
assumptions: Rational interval endpoints satisfy lower ≤ upper where stated; tolerance satisfies 0 ≤ ε where stated.
claims.statement: Valid intervals and ε ≥ 0 cannot be both FEASIBLE and VIOLATED.
claims.ceiling: Requires ordered endpoints and nonnegative tolerance.

claims.name: Experiments.Pal24IntervalSlack.feasible_not_contact
claims.statement: Ordered endpoints exclude simultaneous FEASIBLE and CONTACT.

claims.name: Experiments.Pal24IntervalSlack.violated_not_contact
assumptions: Rational interval endpoints satisfy lower ≤ upper where stated; tolerance satisfies 0 ≤ ε where stated.
claims.statement: Valid intervals and ε ≥ 0 exclude simultaneous VIOLATED and CONTACT.
claims.ceiling: Requires ordered endpoints and nonnegative tolerance.

claims.name: Experiments.Pal24IntervalSlack.feasible_iff_classified
claims.statement: FEASIBLE classifier tag iff the raw feasible predicate holds, for every tolerance and interval.

claims.name: Experiments.Pal24IntervalSlack.violated_iff_classified
assumptions: Rational interval endpoints satisfy lower ≤ upper where stated; tolerance satisfies 0 ≤ ε where stated.
claims.statement: For valid interval and nonnegative tolerance, VIOLATED tag iff its predicate.

claims.name: Experiments.Pal24IntervalSlack.contact_iff_classified
assumptions: Rational interval endpoints satisfy lower ≤ upper where stated; tolerance satisfies 0 ≤ ε where stated.
claims.statement: For valid interval and nonnegative tolerance, CONTACT tag iff its predicate.

claims.name: Experiments.Pal24IntervalSlack.unresolved_iff_classified
claims.statement: UNRESOLVED tag iff all three predicates fail, for every tolerance and interval.
claims.residual: No diagnosis of why uncertainty remains.

claims.name: Experiments.Pal24IntervalSlack.source_regions_pairwise_disjoint
assumptions: Rational interval endpoints satisfy lower ≤ upper where stated; tolerance satisfies 0 ≤ ε where stated.
claims.statement: Three named source regions are pairwise disjoint on valid intervals with ε ≥ 0.

claims.name: Experiments.Pal24IntervalSlack.source_regions_cover
claims.statement: Every raw interval is in a named predicate region or in the complement of all three predicates.
claims.ceiling: Coverage only; invalid intervals can still satisfy multiple predicates.

claims.name: Experiments.Pal24IntervalSlack.classification_total_exclusive
claims.statement: The prioritized classifier returns one mutually exclusive tag for every raw input.
claims.ceiling: Tag partition is guaranteed by the classifier definition; source predicate disjointness has separate validity assumptions.
claims.residual: Does not validate the supplied interval.

claims.name: Experiments.Pal24IntervalSlack.constraintToSlack_endpoints
claims.statement: Endpoint equations for the interval sign reversal.

claims.name: Experiments.Pal24IntervalSlack.positive_tolerance_boundary_is_contact
claims.statement: Singleton slack interval [ε,ε] is CONTACT at ε ≥ 0.

claims.name: Experiments.Pal24IntervalSlack.negative_tolerance_boundary_is_contact
claims.statement: Singleton slack interval [-ε,-ε] is CONTACT at ε ≥ 0.

claims.name: Experiments.Pal24IntervalSlack.cross_regime_interval_is_unresolved
claims.statement: At ε=1, slack interval [-2,2] is UNRESOLVED.

claims.name: Experiments.Pal24IntervalSlack.invalid_interval_overlap_counterexample
assumptions: Explicitly malformed endpoint order; counterexample is outside the valid-interval source domain.
claims.statement: Malformed interval [2,-2] at ε=1 satisfies all three raw predicates while failing validity.
claims.ceiling: Counterexample only to omitting interval-order condition.
claims.residual: Outside the source precondition; no in-domain defect.

claims.name: Experiments.Pal24IntervalSlack.budgetSlack
claims.statement: Fixed budget minus cumulative consumption.

claims.name: Experiments.Pal24IntervalSlack.budget_slack_antitone
assumptions: One fixed budget and one grant epoch; cumulative consumption is nondecreasing.
claims.statement: Nondecreasing cumulative consumption makes fixed-budget slack nonincreasing.
claims.residual: Applies within one fixed epoch only.
